title: Coordination Chemistry
description: A metal ion holds a ring of molecules round it, and their field decides its colour, its magnetism and what it catches; haem's iron, holding oxygen and letting it go. Unlocks the Coordination Reactor.

puzzle.goal: Six ligands split a metal's orbitals by D; pairing two electrons costs P. For a d⁶ ion, write the energy gained g by going low spin (all six paired in the lower three orbitals) instead of high spin.
puzzle.name: Crystal-field balance
puzzle.ask: Find g in eV for D = @{D} eV and P = @{P} eV.
puzzle.method: High spin: four low, two high (−0.4·4 + 0.6·2 = −0.4 Δ). Low spin: six low (−2.4 Δ) but two more pairs (2P).
